tickets.title: Obtain term policy lapse remediation information from the carrier
tickets.text: Obtain reinstatement terms, catch-up premium, conversion availability, and any underwriting requirements from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance for Arlo Copperwisp’s term policy lapse notice following the failed automatic draft from the closed Pocket Lantern Bank account.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain that carrier information by March 1, 2024.

tickets.title: Collect current property and casualty declarations
tickets.text: Obtain current declarations for the Copperwisp household’s home, auto, umbrella, and Bend rental property. The advisory file and client portal lack current declarations, and the older portal copies do not confirm the latest renewal coverage limits.
tickets.evidence: Current declarations are needed by March 8, 2024.

tickets.title: Review rental condo protection
tickets.text: Review insurance protection for the Copperwisp household’s Bend rental condo, covering landlord, tenant, liability, property loss, and loss-of-rent exposures.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review that protection by March 15, 2024.

tickets.title: Compare employer benefits with private coverage
tickets.text: Compare Moonbadger Robotics’ supplemental life, disability, and beneficiary settings with the Copperwisp household’s private coverage before the benefits election portal closes.
tickets.evidence: the supplemental life, disability, and beneficiary settings need comparison with the private coverage before the portal closes. That comparison is needed by March 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain current life insurance beneficiary evidence
tickets.text: Obtain current beneficiary evidence from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance to resolve the discrepancy between the carrier portal and the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file before the protection review is finalized.
tickets.evidence: the Velvet Acorn Life Insurance portal shows a different beneficiary arrangement than the beneficiary summary retained in the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file, so current carrier evidence is needed before the protection review can be finalized. That evidence is needed by March 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request the client's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Address the missing trust funding evidence and fiduciary role information that may not reflect the current household and insurance beneficiary structure.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect the estate planning documents by March 22, 2024.
